tools.name: predict_inputs
tools.description: Predict fu,p and fu,inc from a SMILES, with structure-only human CL and Vss as second opinions. Predictions, not measurements; check the applicability verdict.

tools.name: calc_clhep
tools.description: Hepatic and plasma clearance from in-vitro CLint, fu,mic and fu,p (IVIVE), with the observed-CL band and applicability warnings. If fu,p or fu,mic came from predict_inputs, tell the user the result rests on predicted inputs.

tools.name: target_clint
tools.description: The in-vitro CLint an assay must read for a compound to reach a target plasma clearance (mL/min/kg): calc_clhep run backwards, e.g. to set a CLint cut-off for a screening cascade. Needs fu,mic and fu,p; refuses a target at or above the liver blood flow ceiling and returns that ceiling. Uncorrected I

tools.name: input_sensitivity
tools.description: How far plasma CL moves as each input is varied over a range, e.g. a predicted fu,p over its 50% range.

tools.name: similar_drugs
tools.description: Nearest reference drugs to a SMILES (Tanimoto, Morgan radius 2), each with measured human plasma CL and the CL IVIVE predicted from its measured inputs. Use it to judge how far to trust calc_clhep for this chemotype: if IVIVE missed on the neighbours, expect it to miss here. Returns neighbours only,

tools.name: scale_to_human
tools.description: Predict human plasma CL from observed animal in-vivo CL (rat, dog, monkey), every applicable method with its measured error. Observed animal CL only, never predicted.
